page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: the left page is the main text, with a left-hand column of inscription text and a narrow column of entries (run from top to bottom) and a wide text column to its right; the right page is a running column at the top right with text at the left edge, cut off below. Running head at top of each page. Left margin contains catchword-like "Vicus", "Thuranus", "Tuscus", "Vinquentarius", etc. as marginal index entries; the right column is continuous text.; One column of commentary on the right, with numbered line markers (10, 20, 30, 40, 50) in the margin beside it; below it a short block of notes continuing across the lower left, and a narrow column of marginal notes at the far right edge of the lower part.

main_text.p: MVALERIO M F PAL. AMFRIMINANO.
VIXIT ANNIS XVII. MENSIB. VIII. DIEBVS. OVOBVS. HOR. X.
M. VALERIVS. M. F. AMERIMINVS PATER INFELICISSIMVS FILIO SVAVISSIMO ET DVLCISSIMO FECIT.
NATVS EST IN ROMA IN VICO IV GARIO.
Thuranus. Victor. eumdem ponit cum Lugario. Horat. lib. II. Epist. I. in fine. Quidam hunc Vicum ponunt in XI. Regione.

Tuscus. Rufus, Festus lib. penult. de Verbor. signif. Horat. lib. II. Sermon. Sat. III, & ibi Acron. & Porphyr. Martialis lib. XI. Epig. XXVIII. Varro lib. IV. de LL. Situm indicat Livius apud Marlianum. Acron ad Horatium cum Turnro confundit.
Vinquentarius Major. Victor. Novus. Rufus.
Circomagistri XI IIX. Victor, Rufus.
Curatores II. Idem.
Denunciatores II. Idem.
Cohortes Vigiles VI. Victor.
Umbilicus Urbis Romæ. Idem.

Miliarium aureum. Victor, Plinius lib. nat. Hist. III. cap. V. Suetonius in Othone cap. VI. Macer I C in l. 154. D. de Verbor. signif. ficat Tacitus lib. III. Annal. Vocatur ab Dione lib. XLIV. χρυσοῦν μίλιον, à Plutarcho in Galba χρυσοῦν λίθον.
Porta armentalis. Dixi supra.

Puteal Libonis. Victor, Rufus, Halicarnass. lib. III. in fine, Cicero lib. I. de Div. Horatius lib. II. Sat. Sueton. in Aug. cap. lviii. in Galba cap. xx. Virgil. in Culice haud procul ab fine, Ovid. us lib. iv. Festor. Sudas, Papinius, & alij. Corrigendus Varro, 10 ubi nunc est Roma Septemmontium, demissior infimus locus Lacus.

Hos versus in sequentibus Varro, quod ad Septemmontium, Infimus. Lacus &c. exponit. Lacus vocem addidi, quia Lacus Curtius videtur designari. Error natus ex similitudine vocum, quarum posteriorem, ut Glossema, quidam expuxerant. Sunt autem Versus Trochaici. 20
Pila Horatia, ubi Trophea locata. Victor. Livius lib. i. Dionysius Halicarnass. lib. iv, qui interpretatur γαμαίαι σφαιρα.
Scalae Annulariae. Suetonius in Augusto cap. lxxii. 30

Sub Novis. Varro lib. v. de LL. Interpretantur viri docti de Tabernis, quarum meminit Livius lib. iii. ubi Virginiae Appiique Historia describitur. Sic apud Plautum Sub Veteribus. Vide infra, 40 ubi de Curia Hostilia.

Ad Ianum, secundum Tiberim. Varro lib. iii. de LL. Secundum Tiberim, inquit, Ianium, Forum Piscarium. Emendandum censeo ad Ianum. Nam Templum ... loco. vel ab Ian. celebri Mercatorum loco. Potest & legi ad Ianonem. à Templo Ianonis Martialis, aut Ædes Ianonis Monetae. 50
Luteole ad Jani Templum. V. ro lib. iv. de LL.
Marsyas. Horat. lib. i. Serm. Sat. vi. ibi.
lib. I. de Div. Horatius lib. II. Sat. vi. & lib. I. Epist. xx. ibique Interpretes ejus Acron, Porph. & Lambinus.

page.notes: Printed text in the scan is damaged and partly blank at the right and bottom; the page continues beyond the visible part. Readings of the inscription and of the Greek words are uncertain. The right-hand column is cut off at its edge. Scan is cut off on the left and lower part; the left half of the page is blank. Several words in the lower-left block and the note at left are damaged and partly illegible. Marginal line numbers 10 to 50 are printed in the margin.
